title: BCrypt.Net
description: An alternative BCrypt implementation with compatibility across .NET versions.

data.text: `BCrypt.Net` is a mature, portable BCrypt implementation for .NET. It offers the same BCrypt algorithm as `BCrypt.Net-Next` and is suitable for projects that need broader framework compatibility.
The API is nearly identical to `BCrypt.Net-Next`. Use `BCrypt.HashPassword` to hash and `BCrypt.Verify` to validate.

data.title: Basic Usage
data.content: Hash and verify a password with BCrypt.Net.

terms.definition: A portable BCrypt library for .NET Framework and .NET Core.
Creates a BCrypt hash with an embedded salt.
Safely compares a password to a BCrypt hash.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Choose `BCrypt.Net-Next` for .NET Core and modern projects. Use `BCrypt.Net` when you need compatibility with older .NET Framework versions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: BCrypt.Net is a portable alternative to BCrypt.Net-Next
data.takeaway: Both BCrypt packages use the same secure algorithm; choose based on your target framework.
